name: cable reel on its carrying frame
about: Made by tools/battle-models (prop). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 webbing, 24 bakelite, 25 wire, 26 zinc

parts.name: reel
parts.note: on the ground under the drum's axle, the frame's feet down

parts.name: drum
parts.note: turns as wire pays out (+: the wire goes out forward, off the bottom)
